beats.care: Expect tighter water supply in Hyderabad. Fix leaks and don't waste water at home or in your PG.
beats.what: At a review meeting, the CM said Telangana's drinking water shortage could continue until July next year.
beats.why: El Niño weakened the monsoon. He said reservoirs hold less than 200 tmcft and temperatures will rise.

cards.body: He asked people to adapt like they did during the pandemic. A special scheme will give daily work to workers for four months after Sankranti, until May. The BJP asked for an all-party meeting.
The CM said El Niño is hitting other places too, like Maharashtra.
cards.caption: How long the crisis may last

cards.body: The CM said opponents blame his government for 'bringing drought', but El Niño is a global weather pattern.

cards.q: Has water supply dropped in your area?
Why might Telangana face water shortage till July?
cards.why: El Niño led to poor rains, so reservoirs are low.

cover.label: water left in Telangana's reservoirs, says the CM

hook: Telangana's water crisis may last till *July*, CM warns

learn.t: El Niño is a warming of the Pacific Ocean that often weakens India's monsoon.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: El Nino-induced crisis may persist till July: CM (print, Hyderabad edition, 24 Oct, p.6)

tldr: CM Revanth Reddy said El Niño could keep Telangana short of drinking water until July and asked people to save water and power.
watch: Watch for water supply schedules from the Hyderabad water board and the job scheme's launch after Sankranti.
